# Topological_Reservoir

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reservoir computing architecture where the fixed, random recurrent layer is replaced by a topologically engineered network with controlled connectivity patterns. It leverages network topology to improve computational capacity and stability in TCC-based learning systems.
